summary.content:
Today's selection covers 69 articles from 7 trusted sources, including 45 on Artificial Intelligence and 13 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Critical Copilot vulnerability allowed hackers to seal 2FA code from users
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Ransomware gang abuses Microsoft Teams relays to hide malicious traffic
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, data breaches, scams
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from Ars Technica, The Verge, BleepingComputer, SecurityWeek, TechCrunch and others
• **Fresh Content**: 52 articles published in the last 24 hours
